For Danoya 💗

A poem, with all my heart

🎙️ Listen while you read
I

You're kind and you're sweet, you're caring and true,
You light up my world with the things that you do.
So loving, so warm, a heart made of gold,
The sweetest I've met, and the best I could hold.

II

You're pretty, you're precious, you give back as much,
You notice the details, you care with your touch.
Passionate, smart, intelligent, bright,
Interesting too, you're a pure delight.

III

You're clever and quick with a brilliant mind,
A heart that is gentle, and gorgeous, and kind.
You study and strive and you work till you shine,
And I'm proud of you, baby, you're truly divine.

IV

Every outfit you wear tells me something of you,
Every color you pick has a meaning, it's true.
Your style is a story I love to read,
The exact kind of beautiful I need.

♪ ♪ ♪

Oh Danoya, my Danoya, my sun, my delight,
I think of you morning, and noon, and night.

V

Your eyes hold a warmth that I can't ignore,
Your smile is the sunrise I'm waiting for.
Your laugh is a song, and I'd listen all day,
It chases the clouds of my worries away.

VI

You're gorgeous, you're sexy, I'll say it out loud,
And that top tier booty has made me so proud.
Not sorry at all, I will say it with glee,
You're the best masterpiece that my eyes ever see.

VII

You make me feel seen, and loved, and so known,
Appreciated more than you've ever been shown.
More than you see, more than I'm able to say,
You make me feel precious in every way.

VIII

You remember the little things I say in passing,
Your care is the kind that is steady and lasting.
You give and you listen, you hold and you share,
And I feel it in every word, everywhere.

♪ ♪ ♪

Oh Danoya, my Danoya, my sun, my delight,
I think of you morning, and noon, and night.

IX

You pour out your love like a river in spring,
And I'll learn every day how to give the same thing.
Love goes both ways, and I promise to be
The one who cares for you as you care for me.

X

Our calls turn to hours, the hours feel like minutes,
Every laugh, every story, my whole heart is in it.
You ask for the call and you start it each time,
And somehow the distance is easy to climb.

XI

Our Korra nights and our long winding calls
Are the best of my days, and the best of them all.
Whatever we watch, whatever we do,
It's my favorite moment because it's with you.

XII

We look at one moon from two different skies,
And I see it reflected so bright in your eyes.
No distance is big, and no ocean's too wide
To keep you from walking right here by my side.

♪ ♪ ♪

Oh Danoya, my Danoya, my sun, my delight,
I think of you morning, and noon, and night.

XIII

All I want is to see you, all of you, more,
To talk to you more than we ever did before.
To hold your hand tight and to talk without end,
My favorite person, my love, and my friend.

XIV

One day there'll be no more screens in between,
Just you and just me and the sweetest of scenes.
I'll hold you so long that the world will stand still,
And I'll be right there, and I always will.

XV

I'm thankful for everything, all that you do,
Each message, each laugh, each "I'm thinking of you".
I'd never take you for granted, no way,
I'll show you I love you every single day.

XVI

So here is my poem, with all of my heart,
A tiny piece of a much bigger part.
You're my sun, my Danoya, my light,
My favorite person, day and night.

Sealed with love, always yours💗
